summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by QIAGEN N.V., a foreign private issuer, reporting its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The press release includes GAAP and non-GAAP measures, reconciliations, and constant currency analysis. There are no mentions of acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings report with no special-situation event, serving only to update the market on financial performance.
